name: Music In The Church
overview: Scripture highlights music in the church as a vital expression of worship and spiritual encouragement. Believers are called to sing praises that glorify God’s mercy and confess His name, as seen in Romans 15:9. Ephesians 5:19 instructs Christians to engage one another with psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs, making melody in their hearts to the Lord. Furthermore, James 5:13 encourages singing as a response to joy, demonstrating that music is both a personal and communal means of honoring God within the church.
